budget-ish notes to self

not tracking everything against a number, just the two things that actually
worry me:

- eating out / coffee: want to keep this under $260 a month. it's been
  creeping up and i don't think i'm noticing it day to day.
- amazon/shopping in general: it's probably my biggest category overall but
  i've got more slack there, roughly $1200/month is fine, just want to keep
  an eye on it so it doesn't quietly become $2000.

everything else (groceries, gas, subscriptions, etc) i'm not budgeting
against a specific number right now, just want to see where it's going.

I added up all 198 entries (62 in June, 57 in July, 79 in August) and sorted them by month and category. Three entries need your input before you rely on the totals; they're listed below the tables.

## Spending by month and category

| Category | June | July | August | Quarter total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Shopping | $1,020.77 | $756.72 | $1,218.31 | $2,995.80 |
| Groceries | $624.34 | $883.32 | $982.79 | $2,490.45 |
| Travel (August trip) | – | – | $1,631.82 | $1,631.82 |
| Health & Fitness | $354.24 | $281.16 | $232.79 | $868.19 |
| Gas & Auto | $133.63 | $274.59 | $426.99 | $835.21 |
| Dining & Coffee | $212.74 | $165.14 | $398.69 | $776.57 |
| Transfers & Cash | $271.20 | $105.79 | $269.74 | $646.73 |
| Subscriptions & Bills | $188.59 | $188.59 | $188.59 | $565.77 |
| Rideshare & Parking | $327.78 | $99.08 | $135.59 | $562.45 |
| Entertainment | $143.42 | $135.51 | $160.88 | $439.81 |
| **Total** | **$3,276.71** | **$2,889.90** | **$5,646.19** | **$11,812.80** |

**How I grouped things:**
- **Dining & Coffee:** Local Coffee Co, Starbucks, Chipotle, McDonald's, Panera, Sushi Kame, Thai Orchid, Luigi's, Bagel Corner and Rustic Tap Brewery.
- **Shopping:** Amazon, Best Buy, Target, REI, Old Navy, IKEA, Barnes & Noble and Home Depot.
- **Groceries:** Costco, Trader Joe's, Kroger, Aldi and Whole Foods.
- **Transfers & Cash:** Zelle, Venmo, PayPal and ATM withdrawals.
- **Subscriptions & Bills:** the Amazon Prime charge counts here, not under Shopping.

## Budget comparison

| Month | Dining budget | Dining actual | Over/under | Shopping budget | Shopping actual | Over/under |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| June | $260 | $212.74 | –$47.26 | $1,200 | $1,020.77 | –$179.23 |
| July | $260 | $165.14 | –$94.86 | $1,200 | $756.72 | –$443.28 |
| August | $260 | $398.69 | **+$138.69** | $1,200 | $1,218.31 | **+$18.31** |

## Month-to-month changes and trends

- **August was about twice a normal month.** It came to $5,646, against $3,277 in June and $2,890 in July. The Aug 14–15 trip (flights, hotel, rental car, airport parking) was $1,632 of that. Without the trip, August is about $4,014, which is still the highest of the three months.
- **Dining jumped 141% in August, from $165 to $399.** Restaurant and coffee visits rose from about 14 in July to about 27 in August, and Chipotle, Rustic Tap, Panera and Luigi's all repeated. Dining was under budget in June and July, so August looks like a break from the pattern, not a slow creep. Your notes say you feel it creeping up, and August is the first month it actually crossed the line.
- **Shopping dipped in July and then rebounded.** It went from $1,021 to $757 to $1,218. August is just over your $1,200 line, driven by Amazon ($221), Best Buy ($157 in the first half and $183 on Aug 31), REI, Old Navy and Barnes & Noble. At $3,000 for the quarter, shopping is your largest category, but the quarterly average of about $999 a month is under budget.
- **Groceries rose every month, from $624 to $883 to $983 (+57% overall).** You have no budget for this, but it is the steadiest upward trend in the log. Costco and Trader Joe's trips are the biggest contributors.
- **Gas rose every month, from $134 to $275 to $427.** Some of the increase may come from fuel stops around the trip.
- **Rideshare and parking fell sharply after June,** from $328 to $99 to $136.
- **Subscriptions and bills are flat at $188.59 a month.**

## The three things to know

1. **August is the only month where you went over budget, and dining is the bigger problem.** Dining ran $139 (53%) over its $260 target. Shopping missed by only $18. Dining was well under budget in June and July, so a few weeks of eating out drove the whole overage.
2. **Your total spending swings far more than your two budgeted categories do.** The trip ($1,632), groceries (+$359 from June to August) and gas (+$293 from June to August) added about $2,300 to August compared with June. None of those is covered by your budget notes, so the budget misses most of the real change. Groceries and gas are the most likely to keep growing, so a rough target for them might help.
3. **Shopping is under your $1,200 target on average but moves a lot from month to month.** It stayed under budget in two of three months and averaged about $999. The $2,000 you worry about hasn't happened, and the worst month was only $18 over. The risk is that August's rebound continues into September, so it's worth watching.

## Items that need your input

- **Delta flights:** two charges on Aug 14 ($412.60 and $450.60) look like one booking entered twice with a typo. I counted both, so travel may be overstated by $412.60 or $450.60.
- **Trader Joe's on Jul 22:** two identical $54.12 charges appear back to back. If that's a duplicate entry, July groceries and the total are $54.12 too high. I counted both.
- **Target and Costco:** I put Target under Shopping and Costco under Groceries. If you'd rather count Target as groceries, shopping drops by $421 over the quarter and groceries rise by the same amount. August shopping would fall to about $1,091 and be under budget.
- **REI return:** the –$68.00 refund in July is netted into July shopping.

If you confirm the duplicates and tell me how you want Target and Costco classified, I can rerun the totals.
